item.title: Rescuers race to save exotic lizard found buried alive under nearly 2 feet of snow after massive storm
item.description: An Exotic tegu lizard found buried under 20 inches of snow in Rhode Island after a winter storm made a remarkable recovery despite frostbite and severe weakness.

item.title: US approves massive arms sales to Israel and Saudi Arabia for more than $15 billion amid Middle East tensions
item.description: The U.S. has approve $15.67 billion in arms sales to Israel and Saudi Arabia amid ongoing Gaza ceasefire talks and rising Iran tensions in the region.

item.title: Former LSU star Tyrann Mathieu recalls nearly dying trying to pass drug test: 'Tried everything in the books'
item.description: Long before winning a Super Bowl with the Kansas City Chiefs, Tyrann Mathieu admitted, he went to desperate lengths to pass drug tests in college.

item.title: Left-wing activists storming synagogue use knee pads, adult diaper to mock Dem congressman over ICE vote
item.description: Viral video shows protesters disrupting Rep. Tom Suozzi at Long Island temple over ICE funding vote, using crude props and profane insults during event.

item.title: Girl caught on video pulling single square as 63,000-beer-coaster tower for Guinness World Records collapses
item.description: An artist's month-long beer coaster sculpture from 63,000 pieces intended for Guinness World Records tumbles after a young girl triggers a dramatic collapse caught on video.

item.title: 'Border czar' Tom Homan sets the record straight about his mission in Minneapolis
item.description: Trump's "border czar" Tom Homan vows no surrender on mass deportation promise after being sent to Minneapolis to replace previous Border Patrol commander.

item.description: NFL Giants co-owner Steve Tisch said conversations with Jeffrey Epstein involved "adult women," movies and investments, and said that he never visited the island.

item.title: Government shuts down again after Democrats revolt over DHS funding
item.description: Congress failed to pass a new funding deal in time, triggering the second partial government shutdown in six months as federal agencies prepare for potential closure.
